name: Stock Firefox WebGL feasibility probe

on:
  push:
    branches: ["ci/firefox-webgl-feasibility"]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/firefox-webgl-probe.yml"
      - "ci/webgl_probe.py"
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  probe:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/ci/firefox-webgl-feasibility'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: ci/webgl_probe.py
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - name: Probe normal headed Firefox without preference overrides
        run: python3 ci/webgl_probe.py
      - name: Preserve narrow evidence, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@330a01c490aca151604b8cf639adc76d48f6c5d4 # v5.0.0
        with:
          name: firefox-webgl-probe-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: webgl-probe-results/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3
          include-hidden-files: false
